# t46: Design Trust Mark for Vine-o-Code Outputs
## Type: Safety/Design | Phase: 2 | Status: 🟡 OPEN — High priority
## Auto-generated: Feb 20, 2026

### Context
Safety Gate G9 (Trust Mark Integrity) is open. When community organisations build tools using Vine-o-Code, there needs to be a clear distinction between "reviewed by Kamunity" and "built using Vine-o-Code methodology."

### Two Trust Marks

**Mark 1: "Built by Kamunity"**
- Kamunity directly built and is responsible for this tool
- Reviewed against all 11 constitutional principles
- Safety gates checked
- Ongoing maintenance commitment
- Only on tools in the SITES list (kamunity.org, audit, readiness, etc.)

**Mark 2: "Built using Vine-o-Code"**
- Community org used the Vine-o-Code methodology to build this
- Methodology only — Kamunity is not responsible for this tool's safety
- Must include: disclaimer, contact for the building org, date built
- Community reporting mechanism: "something wrong with this tool? Report it"

### Visual Design Requirements
- Both marks should be visually distinct (different colours, different icons)
- "Built by Kamunity" = authoritative (🔥 Kamunity orange, verified checkmark)
- "Built using Vine-o-Code" = methodology mark (🌿 vine green, no checkmark — just the vine)
- Both link to kamunity.org/trust-marks (page to be created)

### Community Reporting Mechanism
- Simple form: "I found a problem with this Vine-o-Code tool"
- Goes to Waymaker → Mike → investigation
- Response: acknowledge within 48hrs, investigate within 1 week

### Constitutional Check
✅ G9 — Trust Mark Gate (this plan closes it)
✅ Principle 4 (Trust Mark Integrity) — clear distinction prevents misleading users

### Next Step
Design phase: sketch both marks (can use Canva or Cascade to generate SVGs). Then build the /trust-marks page on kamunity.org. Then add reporting form.
Time estimate: 3 hours design + 2 hours Cascade build.
